# simplemdm_munki_pkginfo (Resource)

Manages the Munki pkginfo XML/PLIST blob attached to a Munki app. Apply uploads the supplied file via POST; Delete clears it via DELETE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplemdm_munki_pkginfo" "internal_app" {
  app_id   = simplemdm_app.internal_app.id
  filename = "internal_app.plist"
  pkginfo  = file("${path.module}/internal_app.plist")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Required. App ID to attach the pkginfo to.
- `pkginfo` (String) Required. Pkginfo XML/PLIST contents (the body of the file).

### Optional

- `filename` (String) Optional file name to send (default: `munki_pkginfo.plist`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `munki_pkginfo:<app_id>`.
- `pkginfo_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the supplied pkginfo content (used to detect drift).
